commonPrompt:
Create ONE high-fidelity portrait MOBILE WEB viewport for CELAHAN, a portfolio/coursework security-assessment simulation. This is a responsive website, NOT a native app. Use the supplied desktop reference for brand/content, but recompose for a roughly 390px-wide phone, tall 9:19.5 portrait ratio. Edge-to-edge screen-only output maximizes UI readability: no device bezel, stage, collage, perspective, OS status bar, native tab bar, fake browser chrome, desktop columns, or tiny scaled desktop screenshot. One image = one readable viewport/scroll segment. Content may continue below; do not squeeze an entire long page into one screen.
BRAND: warm almost-black #0C0D0B, charcoal fields, ivory #F3F0E8, sand #C9BA8C actions/emphasis. Large substantial sans headings, occasional sand italic-serif emphasis, readable sans body, monospace only paths/IDs. Match approved dim matte pet illustrations, no Minecraft humanoids, purple gradients, brilliant portals, neon or glossy generic cards. Flat layout with deliberate thin rules, modest rounded-rectangle controls, about24px side gutters, comfortable16px-equivalent body and labels, 44px-equivalent touch controls. No red/green risk/status badges: sand/neutral outlined labels and explicit words. No decorative icons except navigation/disclosure/function.
MOBILE SHELL when requested: quiet CELAHAN wordmark, ID / EN language control and labeled Menu button. Functional screens use small header and clear page heading, not repeated marketing hero. Footer occurs only on a final page segment; do not repeat it in every scroll screenshot. When requested, show the exact readable line 'Proyek konsep untuk portofolio dan tugas kuliah. Bukan layanan sungguhan.' EN also shows 'A concept project for a portfolio and university coursework. Not a real service.' Screens are original UI references, not posters.
BOUNDARIES: never imply real scanning, submitted data, staff response, actual booking/payment, authentication, AI/API, automated repair, logs, timestamps, certificates, testimonials, client statistics or 100% safety. Ticket DEMO-A1B2C3D4 is an example only. Input addresses never accessed. All findings fixed illustrative data. Each screen has one clear purpose and concise copy; no filler or repetitive explanation. Do not invent features. Preserve specified text/data.
